useCases.title: Automated Sprint Completion Summary
useCases.problem: Sprint completion reporting required manually retrieving delivery metrics from Jira and communicating the results to the team, creating repetitive effort and inconsistent reporting.
useCases.automation: When a Jira sprint completes, Jira Automation collects relevant sprint metrics, builds a structured JSON payload, and sends it through a webhook to Power Automate. Power Automate processes the payload, formats the sprint summary, and publishes it to Microsoft Teams.

useCases.title: Multi-Squad Dynamic Channel Routing
useCases.problem: Multiple squads needed automation notifications delivered to their own Teams channels. Maintaining a separate flow per squad created duplication and growing maintenance overhead.
useCases.automation: One shared Jira-to-Power-Automate integration uses Switch/Condition routing logic to identify the squad from the payload and dynamically deliver the notification to the correct Teams channel.

useCases.title: Ready-for-Rollout Notification
useCases.problem: When work became ready for rollout, relevant people needed timely visibility without relying entirely on manual messages or checking Jira.
useCases.automation: When a Jira issue transitions to 'Ready for Rollout', Jira Automation sends a webhook to Power Automate, which formats and delivers a structured Teams notification with key issue details.

useCases.title: New Bug Alert Automation
useCases.problem: Newly reported bugs had no automatic visibility. Teams depended on someone manually posting to a channel, meaning defects could sit unnoticed until the next standup or check-in.
useCases.automation: When a Bug is created in Jira, Jira Automation validates the issue type, extracts key bug details, and sends a structured JSON payload via webhook to Power Automate, which formats and delivers an alert to Microsoft Teams.

useCases.title: Dynamic Microsoft Teams Adaptive Cards
useCases.problem: Plain text automation notifications are difficult to scan and provide limited structure for operational information delivered to Microsoft Teams.
useCases.automation: Power Automate receives a JSON payload from Jira via webhook, maps dynamic values, and constructs a structured Adaptive Card posted to Microsoft Teams — transforming raw data into a readable, actionable notification.

useCases.title: Jira to Power Automate Webhook Integration
useCases.problem: Teams need a reliable, reusable pattern for triggering external workflows from Jira events without building bespoke point-to-point integrations each time.
useCases.automation: Jira Automation uses Smart Values to construct a JSON payload and sends it via HTTP POST to a Power Automate HTTP trigger. Power Automate parses the payload and executes any downstream business logic — notifications, routing, reporting, or data transformation.

useCases.title: Automated Team Leave Planner
useCases.problem: Collecting team leave plans through repeated manual messages makes coordination cumbersome and responses difficult to consolidate.
useCases.automation: A scheduled Slack Workflow Builder automation asks team members for their leave information on a recurring basis and captures structured responses in a shared location for team visibility.

useCases.title: Automated Sprint Review Reporting
useCases.problem: Sprint Review preparation can require gathering delivery information from multiple Jira issues and manually organising statistics and completed work — creating overhead before every review.
useCases.automation: Use Jira data and automation to collect relevant sprint information, aggregate delivery metrics, and present them in a structured Sprint Review report for stakeholder visibility.

useCases.title: GitHub → Channel Notifications
useCases.problem: How to send GitHub push notifications to communication channels using webhooks, and progressively enhance the integration with middleware, payload transformation and webhook security.
